description: Hour by hour UV Index forecast for a US ZIP code or city and state, in the local time of that place, read now from EPA. Returns each hour with its EPA band, the peak hour and the window when UV is 3 or higher. Use it for "when is the sun strongest today" and "what time is safe to be outside" questions.

city.description: US city name, for example "Phoenix". Needs state.

state.description: Two-letter state code for the city, for example "AZ".

zip.description: US ZIP code, 5 digits, for example "33101". Use this or city plus state.

name: get_uv_index_hourly
title: Get hourly UV index forecast
